title: Part13 - minion/MCP handler 接线（接已完成 Rust cycle + CLI verbs）
description: 将 crates/zbrain-core/src/minions/handlers/ 下 19 个 not_implemented 桩接到已完成 Rust 子系统：cycle-phase 经 run_cycle、现有 CLI verb 直接 delegate、无 verb/死技术/LLM-seam 单独决策。

1.label: Part13 - minion/MCP handler 接线（接已完成 Rust cycle + CLI verbs）

decisions.q: Part13 范围如何界定？minions/handlers 有 19 个 not_implemented 桩，分几类、先做什么？
decisions.answer: 按可接线性分四簇：cycle-phase(7,经 run_cycle)、现有 verb(3,integrity/reindex/sync)、无 verb(6,命令未迁/死技术)、LLM/embedding-seam(3,需 infra)。先机械簇(1-1+1-2)后阻塞簇(1-3+1-4)。
decisions.note: 核查依据：CLI verbs 仅 Integrity/Reindex/Sync 存在；extract/integrity_auto/lint/lint_fix/repair_jsonb/sync_retry_failed 无对应 Rust verb（选项 C 删除 TS 命令后无替代，部分属 KNOWN-GAPS G74/G78；repair_jsonb=pglite 死技术）。cycle-phase 七桩全部可经 run_cycle(支持 phase 过滤) 机械接线。LLM/embedding 三桩需 embedding client / ChatProvider 注入（G30/G41/G60 相关）。backlinks.rs 已实现为 delegate 模板：读 ctx.data → 调引擎 op → 返回 JSON。

decisions.q: Part13 19 个 minion handler 桩是否全部抵达终态？
decisions.answer: yes - 12 wired (1-1 cycle phases 7 + 1-2 existing-verb 3 + 1-4 LLM/embedding seam 2) + 6 wontfix (1-3) + 1 contextual_reindex (G84 resolved) — handler code 全部抵达终态，路线图状态待翻

1-1.label: cycle-phase minion handler 接线（delegate 到 run_cycle / 指定 phase）

decisions.q: 如何将 7 个 cycle-phase minion handler 接到 run_cycle？
decisions.answer: 每个 handler 构造 CycleOpts（ctx.data 读 dir/dry_run/pull/source_id，brain_dir 默认空串）后调 run_cycle；autopilot_cycle 用 phases=None 跑完整 cycle，其余 6 个用 phases=Some([特定 CyclePhase]) 跑单 phase，返回 CycleReport 序列化为 JSON。
decisions.note: 验证：cargo test -p zbrain-core --lib minions::handlers 7 个新测试全 ok（InMemory engine，autopilot_cycle 用 dry_run=true 防重副作用）。模板仿 backlinks.rs（读 ctx.data -> 调引擎 -> 返回 JSON）。LLM 依赖子步骤在无 ChatProvider 时按 run_cycle 既有行为 Skipped，与 CLI dream 一致。注意：lib 另有 14 个无关模块测试（search/dedup/fusion/intent、operation think dispatch、skillify、think entity/gather/sanitize）在本分支已失败，非本次改动引入（未触碰相关文件），属预存负债/环境相关，留待独立排查。

1-2.label: 现有 Rust CLI verb delegate handler 接线

decisions.q: How to split the 1-2 existing-verb cluster given reindex needs the embedding seam?
decisions.answer: Wire integrity (scan_integrity) and sync (registry.dispatch_json sync_brain) as mechanical handlers now; defer reindex (requires EmbeddingClient::from_env) to the 1-4 embedding-seam group so it is not half-wired.

decisions.q: Round 3 grill：剩余 5 个 blocked handler（lint/lint_fix/integrity_auto/sync_retry_failed/repair_jsonb）保持 wontfix 还是复活？
decisions.answer: 保持 wontfix。逐个核对确认：与 extract 不同，这 5 个在 Rust 均无隐藏实现——CLI 无 lint/lint_fix/integrity_auto/sync_retry_failed verb（仅 Integrity/Sync 已接）；G65（cycle Lint 臂诚实 Skipped）、G51（integrity auto/review 未迁）、G78（repair-jsonb pglite 死技术）证实缺口真实存在。repair_jsonb → G78 按 Q2=A 直判 wontfix。
decisions.note: 缺陷发现：handler 代码的 G-ID 交叉引用相对 KNOWN-GAPS 整体 off-by-one —— lint.rs→G81（应为 G80）、lint_fix.rs→G82（应为 G81）、integrity_auto.rs→G83（应为 G82）、sync_retry_failed.rs→G84（应为 G83；而 G84 实为已 resolved 的 contextual_reindex 缺口）。repair_jsonb.rs→G78 正确。另 lint.rs 注释谎称 'lint 行为由 run_cycle 覆盖'（G65：cycle Lint 臂实际 Skipped）。建议后续代码修复：将 4 个 handler 的 G-ID 对齐 KNOWN-GAPS（G80-G83）+ 修正 lint.rs 注释。此为代码层修复，不在本次路线图 JSON 改动范围。

1-3.notes: extract (1-3-3) 已复活为 completed（G74/G76 1-2-4）；其余 5 个（lint/lint_fix/integrity_auto/sync_retry_failed/repair_jsonb）保持 wontfix （Round 3 grill 确认：Rust 无对应 verb / 死技术，非误标）。

1-4.label: LLM/embedding-seam handler 接线（需 infra 注入）

decisions.q: How to wire the 3 embedding-seam handlers + deferred reindex?
decisions.answer: Wire reindex/embed/embed_backfill/contextual_reindex via shared embed_pages helper (list_pages/list_stale_pages -> EmbeddingClient::from_env + embed_batch -> put_page_embedding), feature-gated behind 'embedding'. contextual_reindex performs the embed loop but defers per-chunk LLM context synthesis (needs ChatProvider injected into handler ctx) -> tracked G84. Without the feature or a configured ZEROENTROPY_API_KEY the handlers fail with a clear error.

decisions.q: contextual_reindex per-chunk LLM context augmentation (G84) how implemented?
decisions.answer: ChatProvider injected via registry DI same as subagent: ContextualReindexHandler::new(chat_provider) registered with Arc::clone in register_builtin_handlers. handle synthesizes per-page context via LLM then embeds context+compiled_truth; LLM failure falls back per-page to raw compiled_truth (llm_context_failures counted, report marked partial). embed_pages_augmented takes (slug,source_id,text) triples reusing put_page_embedding. G84 now resolved 2026-08-08.

decisions.q: 1-6-3 edges-backfill 实现方式（grill Q1=A 后前提证伪，改为真实核心 port）
decisions.note: IMPLEMENTED (2026-08-15). Grill Q1=A assumed 'pure verb wrapper' but that was WRONG: the core resolveSymbolEdgesIncremental was missing in Rust (CyclePhase::ResolveSymbolEdges is a stub with no match arm; code_edges_symbol/edge_metadata/symbol_name_qualified already exist). Real port: migration 0035 adds content_chunks.edges_backfilled_at (dual dialect); new module crates/zbrain-core/src/symbol_edges.rs ports resolveSymbolEdgesIncremental + processChunkBatch + read_edge_resolution (dialect-neutral: $N placeholders, IN(...) literal id lists, ISO-string watermark param, edge_metadata merge done in Rust). CLI LinksAction::EdgesBackfill wired in zbrain-cli with --source/--all-sources/--max-chunks/--json. Pure unit tests pass; libsql integration covered by CI ubuntu.
